command.description.en-US: Show all todos on the current branch, grouped by status
command.description.zh-CN: 按状态分组显示当前分支的全部任务

command.noTodos.en-US: No todos yet. Ask the agent to add some!
command.noTodos.zh-CN: 暂无任务。可以让智能体添加一些。

shortcut.description.en-US: Collapse or expand the todo widget
shortcut.description.zh-CN: 折叠或展开任务清单组件

tool.description.en-US: Manage a task list for tracking multi-step progress. Actions: create, update, list, get, delete, and clear. Statuses are pending, in_progress, completed, and deleted.
tool.description.zh-CN: 管理用于跟踪多步骤进度的任务清单。操作包括 create、update、list、get、delete 和 clear；状态包括 pending、in_progress、completed 和 deleted。

tool.promptSnippet.en-US: Manage a task list to track multi-step progress
tool.promptSnippet.zh-CN: 使用任务清单跟踪多步骤工作的进度

tool.guideline.1.en-US: Use `todo` for complex work with 3+ steps, when the user gives you a list of tasks, or immediately after receiving new instructions to capture requirements. Skip it for single trivial tasks and purely conversational requests.
tool.guideline.1.zh-CN: 遇到至少 3 个步骤的复杂工作、用户给出任务列表，或刚收到需要记录要求的新指令时使用 `todo`。单个简单任务和纯对话请求不要使用。

tool.guideline.2.en-US: When starting a task from the todo list, mark it in_progress BEFORE beginning work. Mark it completed IMMEDIATELY when done; never batch completions. Keep exactly one task in_progress at a time.
tool.guideline.2.zh-CN: 开始清单中的任务前，先将其标为 in_progress；完成后立即标为 completed，不要批量完成。任何时刻恰好只保留一个 in_progress 任务。

tool.guideline.3.en-US: Never mark a task completed if tests are failing, the implementation is partial, or unresolved errors remain. Keep it in_progress and create a new task for the blocker instead.
tool.guideline.3.zh-CN: 测试失败、实现不完整或仍有未解决错误时，绝不能把任务标为 completed。应保留 in_progress，并为阻塞项创建新任务。

tool.guideline.4.en-US: Task status is a 4-state machine: pending → in_progress → completed, plus deleted as a tombstone. Pass activeForm, a present-continuous label such as 'writing tests', when marking in_progress.
tool.guideline.4.zh-CN: 任务状态是四态机：pending → in_progress → completed，另有作为墓碑的 deleted。标记 in_progress 时传入 activeForm，例如“正在编写测试”。

tool.guideline.5.en-US: To change status, call update with the task id and target status, for example {"action":"update","id":3,"status":"completed"}. An update without a mutable field is rejected.
tool.guideline.5.zh-CN: 修改状态时，使用任务 id 和目标状态调用 update，例如 {"action":"update","id":3,"status":"completed"}。不含可变字段的 update 会被拒绝。

tool.guideline.6.en-US: Use blockedBy to express dependencies. On create, pass blockedBy as the initial set. On update, use addBlockedBy and removeBlockedBy; do not resend the full array. Cycles are rejected.
tool.guideline.6.zh-CN: 使用 blockedBy 表达依赖。创建时传入初始 blockedBy；更新时使用 addBlockedBy 和 removeBlockedBy，不要重传完整数组。循环依赖会被拒绝。

tool.guideline.7.en-US: list hides deleted tombstones by default. Pass includeDeleted:true to include them, and pass status to filter by one status.
tool.guideline.7.zh-CN: list 默认隐藏 deleted 墓碑。传入 includeDeleted:true 可包含它们，传入 status 可按单一状态筛选。

tool.guideline.8.en-US: Subject must be short and imperative, such as 'Research existing tool'. Use description for long-form detail and activeForm for the present-continuous in-progress label.
tool.guideline.8.zh-CN: subject 应简短并使用祈使语气，例如“调研现有工具”。长篇细节放在 description，进行中的持续动作标签放在 activeForm。

schema.subject.en-US: Task subject line; required for create

schema.activeForm.en-US: Present-continuous label shown while status is in_progress, such as 'writing tests'
schema.activeForm.zh-CN: 状态为 in_progress 时显示的持续动作标签，例如“正在编写测试”

schema.status.en-US: For update, set status to pending, in_progress, completed, or deleted. For list, filter by this status.
schema.status.zh-CN: 用于 update 时，将状态设为 pending、in_progress、completed 或 deleted；用于 list 时按该状态筛选。

schema.blockedBy.en-US: Initial dependency task ids for create only
schema.blockedBy.zh-CN: 仅用于 create 的初始依赖任务 id

schema.addBlockedBy.en-US: Task ids to add to blockedBy for update only
schema.addBlockedBy.zh-CN: 仅用于 update：添加到 blockedBy 的任务 id

schema.removeBlockedBy.en-US: Task ids to remove from blockedBy for update only
schema.removeBlockedBy.zh-CN: 仅用于 update：从 blockedBy 移除的任务 id

schema.owner.en-US: Agent or owner assigned to this task
schema.owner.zh-CN: 分配给该任务的智能体或负责人

schema.metadata.en-US: Arbitrary metadata; during update, use null to delete a key
schema.metadata.zh-CN: 任意元数据；update 时将键值设为 null 可删除该键

schema.id.en-US: Task id; required for update, get, and delete
schema.id.zh-CN: 任务 id；update、get 和 delete 时必填

schema.includeDeleted.en-US: For list, include deleted tombstones when true; default false
schema.includeDeleted.zh-CN: 用于 list：为 true 时包含 deleted 墓碑；默认为 false

error.updateRequiresField.en-US: update requires at least one mutable field: subject, description, activeForm, status, owner, metadata, addBlockedBy, or removeBlockedBy
error.updateRequiresField.zh-CN: update 至少需要一个可变字段：subject、description、activeForm、status、owner、metadata、addBlockedBy 或 removeBlockedBy

error.selfBlock.zh-CN: 任务 #{id} 不能依赖自身

error.cycle.en-US: addBlockedBy would create a cycle in the blockedBy graph
error.cycle.zh-CN: addBlockedBy 会在 blockedBy 图中形成循环依赖

result.noChange.en-US: No change: #{id} already matches the requested values (status: {status})
result.noChange.zh-CN: 无变化：#{id} 已与请求值一致（状态：{status}）

config.invalid.en-US: Could not read todo configuration at {path}; defaults are being used: {error}
config.invalid.zh-CN: 无法读取 {path} 中的任务清单配置；当前使用默认值：{error}
